title: Rock Salt

services.name: Athletic Pilates
services.desc: Move to pulse-pounding playlists as you tone, sculpt, and build real strength in classes designed to deliver results, and keep it fun. RockSalt delivers a modern, athletic approach to pilates, where motivating playlists and expert coaching help you move stronger, smarter, and more confidently with every beat. This total-body RockSalt class is built to welcome you in while still bringing the burn. Expect curated music, light cardio, and a strong emphasis on flexibility, alignment, and controlled, isolated movement. This class combines Reformer and Mat pilates fundamentals into a precision-led, music-driven workout. Sequences are choreographed to the beat, building heat as you lengthen,
